title: Looking for testers: a UK spread betting strategy tool that ranks rigor, not returns
author: DeliciousEquipment13
selftext:
I built a tool for UK spread betting that refuses to tell you your strategy is good



Mithos is a strategy builder aimed at UK spread betting specifically tax-free profits under current HMRC treatment, and (once it's open) automated execution through your own IG account. Nothing about that automation is live yet; it's waitlist-only while I sort out the regulatory side properly rather than rush it.



What is live right now, free, worldwide, no broker needed: build a strategy from entry/exit/filter blocks, and run it through the same statistical rigor checks I hold my own research to walk-forward validation across held-back time windows, a placebo control against random entries, and a penalty that gets stricter the more variations you've tried. Most strategies fail this. Mine included I've run several of my own through it and every one so far has been correctly rejected.



That's actually the interesting bit: I added a leaderboard that ranks strategies by how rigorous the evidence is, not by returns — significance, sample depth, robustness across time, that kind of thing. It's opt-in, and only a display name and score ever show, never the strategy itself. Right now it's genuinely empty. Every real strategy tested on the account so far, including mine, has failed to earn a spot. The closest one missed by a hair on statistical significance.



If you build or test strategies and want to see if yours actually holds up or want to be the first name on a leaderboard nobody's cracked yet — here it is: [mithos.co.uk](http://mithos.co.uk)



Happy to answer anything about the methodology, the tax side, or why it's built the way it is.
